verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and complete. It identifies the center with the elements having singleton conjugacy classes, proves via the centralizer-coset bijection that every nonsingleton conjugacy class has size divisible by p, and applies the class equation to conclude that |Z(G)| is divisible by p. Since the identity lies in Z(G), this divisibility implies |Z(G)| is at least p and hence Z(G) contains a nonidentity element. The statement is self-contained, and the proof contains no external references, fact_id citations, hard-prohibition violations, logical errors, or gaps.
